question: Will Harry Kane win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Ballon d’Or.

If no 2026 Ballon d’Or winner is declared by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from France Football (https://www.francefootball.fr/).

evidence.excerpt: The 70th edition of the prestigious award ceremony will take place on 26 October in London. Presented annually by France Football (owned by L'Équipe Group), the award has been co-organised with UEFA since 2024.

The Ballon d’Or will celebrate its 2026 ceremony on Monday 26 October at the London Palladium Theatre in London, England, for the first time. The full list of nominees in all categories is available here. Media representatives wishing to attend and cover the ceremony are invited to submit their accreditation requests by 12 October.

The Ballon d'Or is awarded by an international jury of specialized journalists, with one representative per country: the top 100 nations according to the FIFA rankings for the men's award, and the top 50 for the women's award. Each jury member selects 10 players in descending order of merit from a 30-player shortlist. The 10 selected players receive 15, 12, 10, 8, 7, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 point respectively. The Ballon d'Or is awarded to the player with the highest overall score.

Harry Kane described the 2025-26 campaign as the best season of his life after scoring 73 goals for Bayern Munich and England, and while his performances have made him a leading candidate for the Ballon d'Or he says he is not focused on individual awards. No English player has won the Ballon d'Or since Michael Owen in 2001 and Kane is up against tough competition with Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe also in the running.

Kylian Mbappé has finished UEFA Champions League top scorer for the second time after registering 15 goals in 11 appearances in 2025/26. Harry Kane, who shared the top scorer prize with Mbappé in 2023/24, finished just one behind. The 32-year-old took his tally to 14 in the semi-final second leg between Bayern München and Paris, scoring for the seventh successive outing in the competition.

From 1995 onwards, when the trophy became open to players of all nationalities, the percentage increased: there have been seven World Cups, and in four of them the champions have lifted the Ballon d'Or. That represents a success rate of 57.1 per cent. Since the award was opened up to the whole world in 1995, 100 per cent of the Ballon d'Or podiums have featured at least one world champion from that same year or season.

Troy Deeney has controversially left Harry Kane and Kylian Mbappe out of his top three Ballon d’Or picks. PSG’s Georgian forward Kvicha Kvaratskhelia was named as his third-best player above Kane and Mbappe, with Deeney labelling the Champions League and Ligue 1 winner “unbelievable and probably the best winger in world football”. Deeney named Lamine Yamal as the best player in the world after the teenager won both La Liga with Barcelona and the World Cup with Spain in the summer.
